description.value:
Prerequisites: Red Mage 9, Pool Strike ruby arcana

The red mage can expend 1 additional point from his arcane pool when making a pool strike. A single target of his pool strike takes elemental damage as normal from the pool strike and also takes half this amount of damage at the beginning of its turn on the following round.

system.source: Final Fantasy d20 - Red Mage (Ruby Arcana)
